name: session
description: Interview-first idea refinement (/refine), session handoff notes that let /clear replace /compact (/handoff) with the pivot gate that checks each note against the work item's intent file, and a searchable archive of earlier sessions that follows the handoff chain (/recall).

minGapMinutes.title: Auto-clear minimum gap (minutes)
minGapMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between two automatic /clear runs after a handoff in the same project. 0 disables the gap check; a backstop of 12 clears per hour always applies.
